citation.title: A two-time-scale dynamic-model approach for magnetic and kinetic profile control in advanced tokamak scenarios on JET
citation.authors: D. Moreau, D. Mazon, M. Ariola, G. De Tommasi, L. Laborde, F. Piccolo, F. Sartori, T. Tala, L. Zabeo, et al.

topic: Semi-empirical two-time-scale state-space identification and near-optimal PI profile control (q-profile, rho*_Te) on JET
own_question: Can a reduced-order, experimentally identified linear model support real-time feedback control of magnetic and kinetic profiles using H&CD and PF actuators?
actual_method_and_evidence: Linearized transport structure, Galerkin projection, singular perturbation separation of confinement and resistive time scales, and identification from modulation pulses with fit metrics. Controller design was demonstrated in simulations. Experiments controlled q-profile and qedge only. Kinetic, rho*_Te, control appears only in simulation. The source does not involve CES, ion temperature, BES/ECEI or nowcasting.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Prior JET work identified profile dynamics with separate fast confinement and slow resistive time scales for feedback control, not for diagnostic nowcasting.
claim_checks.qualification: Uses electron temperature and rho*_Te from ECE. The model is linear around a reference state. This is control, not estimation of a delayed report.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Real-time inputs were magnetic reconstruction with interfero-polarimetry and ECE. No report-latency analysis.
validation_if_relevant: Some identification pulses were validated on one held-out pulse (#70318). No untouched campaign-level split is reported.
forbidden_inferences: Do not imply ion or CES temperature was modelled
Do not cite this as nowcasting or fluctuation-diagnostic inference
Do not claim kinetic profile control was achieved experimentally
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Only optional background on time-scale separation in real-time profile control. Its objective and diagnostics differ from our paper.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
